messages:
sam_support: Heads up — got two customer tickets that look like the same ask from Acme (Dedicated): #8942 and #8970. They want tenant-level routing tags for embeddings. Can someone condense and reply with status? cc @riley_sales

alex_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the subject lines / links so we have the exact dup context?

sam_support: Sure — #8942: 'tenant routing for embeddings' https://zendesk/8942, #8970: 'per-tenant route for embed inference' https://zendesk/8970 — same text in body, slightly different examples.

maria_pm: Yep looks identical. Suggest we create a canonical intake item and mark both tickets as duplicates. Need to decide owner & priority (customer on Dedicated).

riley_sales: Acme is pushing for this — Dedicated customer, high business impact. I'd set priority = customer-impact/urgent. But engineering may call it medium scope. We need a clear comms line to avoid repeated pings.

jamie_prodops: Tagging suggestion: `merged-into-INF-###`, `cs:duplicate`, `area:serving-routing`, `impact:dedicated-customer`. Who will own the canonical ticket?

alex_eng: I can own discovery + spec. I'll create a canonical backlog item (INF-412) and scope an MVP: tenant routing tag metadata + router honor. Est spec time = 2w. Implementation TBD after spec.

maria_pm: Good. Acceptance criteria to capture in spec: 1) API allows tenant routing tag on embed requests, 2) smart router uses tag to route to correct pool, 3) automatic fallback to default pool if routing unavailable, 4) e2e tests + docs + rollout plan + privacy/KMS review.

sam_support: Can we send a quick status reply to the customer now so they hear we're tracking it? Draft?

riley_sales: Draft to send from Support: "Thanks — we've consolidated your requests into a single tracked item (internal INF-412). We'll scope a minimal rollout and share a timeline in ~2 weeks. Because you're on Dedicated, we'll prioritize accordingly and keep you updated. If anything changes we'll notify immediately."

jamie_prodops: :thumbsup: That sounds good. Also update both Zendesk tickets with a note: "Merged into INF-412 (internal)." Add `merged-into-INF-412` tag.

alex_eng: I'll create INF-412 now, link the two tickets, and add labels: `cs:duplicate`, `cust:acme`, `prio:customer`. Assign to me. I'll include the fallback SLO and monitoring hooks in the spec.

intake-bot: INF-412 created by alex_eng — https://tracker/INF-412 (labels: cs:duplicate, cust:acme, prio:customer, area:serving-routing)

sam_support: Copy — I'll push the status update to both Zendesk tickets and send the draft reply to the customer.

riley_sales: I'll follow up with Acme privately to set expectations and capture any additional requirements.

maria_pm: Thanks everyone. One ask: after spec is posted, please add a short TL;DR to the backlog card with scope/no-scope bullets so support/sales can reference it.

alex_eng: Will do. I'll post spec link here when ready.

sam_support: Closing the loop on this thread after updates posted to tickets. Thanks all.
